risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially damaged or with hidden defects.

risks.risk: TV is not in working condition or has software issues
risks.proof: Video clip showing the TV powering on, navigating menus, and playing a video from an external source.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working or with functional defects.

risks.risk: TV is not the advertised model (e.g., counterfeit or repurposed)

risks.if_unproven: Priced as unverified model, potentially lower value.

risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the TV.

proof_requests: Photo of the back of the TV showing model and serial number.
Video clip of the TV powering on, navigating menus, and playing a video.
Photo of all included accessories (remote, cables, stand, etc.).
Close-up shot of the screen edges and frame under lighting to check for damage.
response.reason: While the model and key features are supported by on-screen text, critical risks such as physical damage, functionality, and authenticity cannot be verified from current photos. Proof is needed to confirm the TV's condition and completeness before pricing.
